theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsClosed E → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) E → X ω = 0) → X.support ⊆ E) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsClosed X.support) ∧ (∀ A B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (A - B).support ⊆ A.support ∪ B.support) ∧ (0 : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n).support = ∅ ∧ (∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1), A.boundary.support ⊆ A.support)) → (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (E V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = ∫ x in E, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ) → X.massOn V ≤ μ (E ∩ V)) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (A Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (d : Euclid P → ℝ) (r : ℕ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → μ X.supportᶜ = 0 → Continuous d → StrictAnti r → Tendsto (fun j => μ {x | d x < r j}) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), A j ω = ∫ x in {x | d x < r j}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Y 0 ω = X ω - A 0 ω) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), Y (j + 1) ω = A j ω - A (j + 1) ω) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Y 0 ω = ∫ x in {x | r 0 ≤ d x}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), Y (j + 1) ω = ∫ x in {x | r (j + 1) ≤ d x ∧ d x < r j}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, HasSum (fun j => Y j ω) (X ω)) ∧ (∀ j, (Y j).support ⊆ X.support ∩ {x | r j ≤ d x}) ∧ (∀ j, (A j).support ⊆ X.support) ∧ (Y 0).mass ≤ μ univ ∧ (∀ j, (Y (j + 1)).mass ≤ μ {x | d x < r j})
